intro: Chukkallo is the latest Telugu Christmas song written by Pastor Pandu Prem Kumar, sung by Sharon Sisters featuring Sharon Philip, Lillian Christopher, Hana Joyce, tune and music by JK Christopher. This song video was released on December 03, 2022 through Sharon Sisters YouTube channel.
